fatal_errors: The proposed 800–1200 °C tensile/creep regime does not match the reported quasi-static compression, room-temperature scratch testing, and indentation measurements from room temperature to 500 °C.

The asserted refined grain structure, grain-boundary segregation, nanoscale precipitates, and grain-boundary sliding were not established in the target study; the observed mediator was a solidification-segregated dendritic structure containing two BCC phases.
The comparison does not isolate the proposed cause because alloy identity, grain structure, chemistry, phase constitution, and processing history all vary simultaneously.
No prior evidence is cited despite the request for cited support.
The hypothesis extrapolates to fusion-service temperatures and mechanisms outside the experimentally validated range.
explanation: The response addresses the broad question and predicts the correct qualitative direction—greater plastic strain and toughness than pure tungsten—but it does not reconstruct the relevant experiment or its evidentiary limits. The target alloy was an as-cast, repeatedly arc-melted two-BCC dendritic material with W-Ta-rich dendrites and Zr-Ti-rich interdendritic regions, not a demonstrated precipitate-strengthened, refined-grain material. The target interpretations emphasized solid-solution/lattice-distortion strengthening and possible Ti/V/Zr effects on dislocation behavior, cohesion, localized plasticity, and crack impedance; grain-boundary sliding and nanoscale precipitates are speculative additions. The proposed comparison could test overall performance but cannot attribute any difference specifically to grain-boundary heterogeneity. It also omits the quantitative tungsten baseline and observed results, including approximately 6% room-temperature plastic strain, crack disappearance above 200 °C, greater than 20% indentation plastic strain at 500 °C, and toughness of about 38 versus 25 MPa√m. Its falsification rule is additionally too broad because failure to observe segregation would not by itself refute all chemical-complexity mechanisms, while observing correlation would not establish causation.
